international.title: Department for Work and Pensions takes services offline after ‘cyber incident’ – UK politics live
international.summary: The department is working with cyber security experts to restore services and limit disruption Almost all pensions and benefits systems have been knocked offline following a “cyber incident” which hit the department of work and pensions. Anyone trying to check their state pension, make an application for disability benefits or claim universal credit was not able to do so on Friday morning as a result of the incident. DWP officials insist benefit and pensions payments will continue to be made as normal. Turning to the growing divisions within Labour over the Rosebank oilfield, the environment minister Emma Hardy has been asked about the issue during this morning’s media round. Continue reading...
